resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed after the correction batch.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent whole-locale pass identified 25 actionable Nynorsk translation defects; all 25 were resolved in this bounded iteration.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Nynorsk text replaced the low-drain safety warning with a different usage instruction.
evidence: English: Low-drain battery; not suited for vaping.
The replacement preserves both the low-discharge meaning and the vaping suitability warning.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Batteri med låg utladingsstraum; ikkje eigna for damping.

findings.summary: The description retained Bokmål verb, article, and circuit terminology.
evidence: Before: knytter sammen ... i en elektrisk krets.
findings.resolution: Changed to: knyter saman ... i ein elektrisk krins.

findings.resolution: Changed to: Samanhengen.
